title: Justicia downloads can overwrite distinct documents with repeated event numbers
notes: numbers.** Observed 2026-10-22: JVB 174/2020 returns 152 document rows but
`writeJusticiaDocument` produces only 104 distinct paths because filenames
use procedure plus event number. A temporary operational build recovered
all versions with unique per-row suffixes; the repository implementation
remains unchanged. Next: use a stable unique document identity in
filenames and test repeated numbers across tree branches.
result: Keep a stable per-document filename when event numbers repeat.
evidence: pnpm exec vitest run src/justicia/documents: repeated event numbers and sanitization-equivalent IDs produce separate files with the correct contents and the same paths on reordered retry.
